svg.title: Resampling moved the operating point, not the ranking
svg.desc: Five average-precision intervals on one axis where the untreated baseline at 0.4927 sits furthest right and every resampling treatment down to random undersampling at 0.3524 sits left of it, beside a Brier-score ladder rising 18.9-fold from 0.0082 to 0.1548, the cost-matrix threshold arithmetic giving 8 over 608 equals 0.01316, a crossed-out maximise-F1 box, and realised-cost bars in which the untreated model at a tuned threshold is the cheapest at GBP 91,232.
